# DataDashOS
> KPI dashboard and AI business coach for owner-led small and mid-sized companies. Built by Simmitri, Inc. (Northern California, est. 1993).

DataDashOS turns siloed accounting, CRM, and marketing data into one KPI view, an AI-written weekly review, and next-step actions.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/): Product overview, how it works, investor contact
- [About](https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/about.html): Operator story, E-E-A-T entity details, geographic roots
- [FAQ](https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/faq.html): Citable Q&A for owners and investors

## Key facts
- Product: DataDashOS (SoftwareApplication / BusinessApplication)
- Company: Simmitri, Inc.
- Location: Northern California, USA
- Operating history: 32+ years
- Stage: Pre-seed
- Integrations: QuickBooks Online, GoHighLevel, Google Ads, CSV import
- Contact: investors@simmitri.com
